title: Keep the evening routine on late days
summary: Make a short version of the routine for your late days.
Keep the full routine on the other days.

sentences: Your routine "Evening reset" has 4 steps and starts at 21:00 [1].
On 3 of the last 4 Thursdays, you completed tasks after 20:00 [2].
On these days, you did not start the routine.
A long routine is difficult to start late in the day.
A short routine with 2 steps is easy to start, and it keeps the habit.

procedure.result: The list of your routines shows.

procedure.text: Make a new routine with the name "Evening reset, short".
Add 2 steps: "Set out clothes" and "Put phone on charger".
Set the days of the new routine to Thursday.

procedure.result: Each day has one evening routine.
note: If your late days change, change the days of the two routines.
